papers.title: Enhancing mass transport in redox flow batteries with 3D-printed triply periodic minimal surface electrode structures
papers.abstract: Triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) structures offer a compelling route for designing porous electrodes with tunable architectures for electrochemical applications such as redox flow batteries. In this study, we fabricated carbonaceous TPMS electrodes, including gyroid, diamond, IWP, and cubic geometries, using digital light processing, and evaluated their performance in single-electrolyte flow cells using an organic redox couple. The printing process and subsequent thermal treatment produced conductive porous electrodes that closely replicated the intended TPMS geometries, preserving the characteristic features of each design. Through a detailed analysis of pressure drop, surface area, and electrochemical behavior, we identified the diamond design as particularly effective in enhancing mass transport while maintaining low hydraulic resistance. We further assessed gyroid structures, selected for being the most well-known among TPMSs, across a range of porosities, finding that higher porosity improved flow performance despite a reduction in surface area, an advantageous trade-off for electrolytes with facile kinetics and low ionic conductivity. Comparison with a commercial carbon felt electrode revealed comparable ohmic resistance and favorable flow characteristics, though reduced electrochemical surface area limited the achievable current densities. To isolate mass transport effects, a kinetically facile organic redox couple was employed, after which a representative 3D-printed gyroid electrode was evaluated in a proof-of-concept full-cell vanadium redox flow battery. A full-cell test demonstrated the feasibility of printed electrodes, achieving a voltage efficiency of 76% at a current density of 50 mA cm−2. These findings demonstrate the potential of architected 3D printed electrodes for future redox flow batteries and highlight the importance of tuning geometry and porosity to balance power output, mass transport, and system-level pumping losses.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究3D打印TPMS电极用于液流电池，与用户关注的骨科植入物多孔结构、应力遮挡和骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses electrochemical mass transport in redox flow batteries and contains no implant mechanics, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no LPBF fabrication, and no osseointegration or fatigue testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索可调孔隙架构的TPMS电极以提升液流电池传质性能。
summary_zh.method: 用数字光处理打印gyroid、diamond、IWP和cubic碳基TPMS电极并测试流动与电化学性能。
summary_zh.result: diamond结构传质最优且水力阻力低，全电池电压效率达76%。
summary_zh.validation: 单电解液流池测试与钒液流全电池概念验证。

summary_en.motivation: The study seeks tunable porous architectures that can improve mass transport in redox flow battery electrodes.
summary_en.method: Carbonaceous TPMS electrodes of gyroid, diamond, IWP, and cubic geometries were printed via digital light processing and characterized in single-electrolyte flow cells.
summary_en.result: The diamond architecture delivered the best mass-transport-to-hydraulic-resistance trade-off, and a printed gyroid full cell reached 76% voltage efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Performance was assessed through pressure-drop, surface-area, and electrochemical measurements plus a proof-of-concept vanadium full-cell test.

papers.title: The Comparative Analysis of Hybrid Sampling, EasyEnsemble, and SVM-SMOTE Performance for Imbalanced Data Based on Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract: Imbalanced data represents a common challenge in classification modeling, as it can lead to prediction bias and reduce the models ability to correctly identify minority classes, which are often more critical. This study aims to compare the performance of three imbalance-handling techniquesHybrid Sampling, EasyEnsemble, and SVM-SMOTEapplied to the XGBoost classifier with hyperparameter tuning using Bayesian Optimization. A simulation study was conducted under a factorial completely randomized design involving three factors: class proportion (70:30, 80:20, 90:10), predictor variable types (10 categorical variables and a combination of 5 categorical and 5 numeric variables), and imbalance handling methods. Model performance was evaluated using balanced accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. During the optimization process, 20 hyperparameter combinations were initially selected as prior evaluation points, followed by 20 additional optimization iterations to refine the search for the optimal hyperparameter configuration. The Bayesian Optimization process produced different optimal hyperparameter combinations for each simulation scenario, reflecting the distinct characteristics of the data under different experimental conditions. The analysis of variance revealed that both the main effects and the interactions among all factors significantly influenced classification performance. Among the evaluated methods, EasyEnsemble consistently achieved the best performance across all class imbalance scenarios. For all class proportions (70:30, 80:20, and 90:10), both in datasets consisting of 10 categorical predictor variables and in datasets comprising a combination of 5 categorical and 5 numerical predictor variables, EasyEnsemble achieved balanced accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity values consistently exceeding 0.90. Furthermore, Bayesian Optimization effectively enhanced the classification performance of XGBoost by efficiently identifying optimal hyperparameter configurations. Overall, the findings demonstrate that the combination of EasyEnsemble and Bayesian Optimization provides an effective approach for addressing class imbalance and improving classification performance.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究不平衡分类的采样方法与贝叶斯超参数优化，与FEA代理建模、仿真采样效率或植入物力学无直接关系。
llm.why_not_core: It addresses class-imbalance resampling for tabular classification, with no surrogate modeling of PDE/FEA, no simulation sampling efficiency, no uncertainty quantification, and no biomechanics or implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 不平衡数据会使分类模型偏向多数类，需比较不同重采样策略的效果。
summary_zh.method: 在三种类别比例与两类预测变量设定下，用贝叶斯优化调参XGBoost并比较三种不平衡处理方法。
summary_zh.result: EasyEnsemble在各场景下平衡准确率、敏感度与特异度均超过0.90，表现最优。
summary_zh.validation: 基于因子完全随机设计的仿真数据实验，以方差分析检验因素效应。

summary_en.motivation: Class imbalance biases classifiers toward majority classes, motivating a systematic comparison of resampling strategies.
summary_en.method: A factorial simulation study tuned an XGBoost classifier via Bayesian optimization and compared Hybrid Sampling, EasyEnsemble, and SVM-SMOTE across class ratios and predictor types.
summary_en.result: EasyEnsemble consistently outperformed the alternatives, exceeding 0.90 balanced accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in all scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Performance was assessed on simulated datasets under a factorial completely randomized design with ANOVA-based factor analysis.
